notes.title: Septemper Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Stickman! It's been a really productive month where I've been finalizing things. Creative Mode is in the best state it's ever been and I'm in the final stretch!



Custom Materials and Textures in the Level Editor

You read that right! You can now import your own textures and create your own materials in the level editor and apply them to Dynamic actors! Materials allow you to change the color and texture of the top and sides of Dynamic actors. You can also apply your custom textures to the materials and have them displayed on Dynamic actors. 

Material Creation Screen

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/5e9ba652e921f979fbf96cd18af0d47064c6a061.png"]

Texture Import Screen

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/57d6bb9249138306962d13379cb8249a4129dd9f.png"]

Material Applied to Actor

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/d1a3f568453ab7ed1f88e444226c4f2a4297e696.png"]

Level Editor Collision Options

I have also added collision options to supported actors. You can change actors to have Default, Background (No Movement), or No Collision

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/87deb714dc53a353ba1cbd595552c3d6ab42ba50.png"]

Level Editor Finalized 

After adding those features, adding all available assets, fixing countless bugs, and adding a lot of Quality of Life features, Creative Mode is now ready for Early Access! I'm almost counting on numerous bugs to be found on release, and the game to be completely broken but I'm excited to see what everyone will create!




A More Cartoonish Look

The game now has a “flatter” and more cartoonish look by changing how the base materials work. It also helps interior scenes not feel extremely dark. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/7f608b269c903064d19381d50ee1ecf345b8e6a9.png"]

Workshop Tags Updated

I've updated the workshop tags to be easier to use. PvE is now part of "Supported Game Modes” instead of a separate level type which makes things a lot cleaner and less confusing. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/1124b878283af534812bca6d9a47ee90afc1c49c.png"]


All levels finalized with new enemy variants

Levels have now been updated with new enemy variants! It should help make the levels less repetitive and bring different challenges and combat. 




New color wheel while drawing skin

When making creative mode custom materials, I added an advanced color wheel to allow better color selection. And this color wheel has also replaced the old one when drawing a skin. A lot of testers asked for hexcode support and this has that!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/b7a70f621281e0b1a11dd840986e9e399db56de7.png"]


Creative Mode Documentation

I've also added creative mode documentation on the games website! If you ever need a reference or more detailed explanation you can look there! Bugs or general help should still be submitted in the Discord. 

https://thestickmangame.com/LevelEditor/



What's Next?

Next I'm working on PvP, bugfixes, balancing, and final level adjustments. In the final stretch now! Next update should be a massive PvP update!

notes.title: August Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello Stickman! I’ve been doing a lot of work behind the scenes but it won’t look like a lot has changed. But I’ll explain everything I’ve added and changed in this monthly update.



Levels

The second world of levels have been finalized. The only difference is the environments are now finished and look better than they did before along with slight encounter adjustments. Along with letters and alvin being hidden on every level. Alvin is WAY more hidden in the second world compared to the first, but the lore and story starts to ramp up. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/430e2f627c4ea7c49d89a9f98d44ff88ab091319.png"]

Enemies

Enemy variation is a lot better than it used to be. In the demo, I got feedback that more enemy variation would be nice and it should feel a lot better in the full release. I’ve also started to create other enemies rather than pink erasers. Now there’s enemies like a Wizard and other ridiculous stuff.

Here's a WIP image of the Wizard Eraser:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/04d656b216f39a9cb54775a517afeb859c36b428.png"]



Level Editor

The plan on release was to have only custom PvP maps supported on release. But PvE and PvP will now both be supported on release, simply because it’s easier to have it supported on launch, and not be added later. PvE will most likely be very limited to start, but will be expanded on after release.. The Steam Workshop for The Stickman is also almost all done and has a lot more tags so finding what you want should be easier. 

Here's an image of what a typical Workshop item might look like on Steam with tags displayed on the right.
The current tags are:

Item Type: Stickman Skin, Picture, or Level

Level Difficulty: Easy to impossible. For PvP this is difficulty to navigate, in PvE its navigation and survivability

Supported Game Modes: Displays all game modes that the map supports. Supported modes all have requirements which are displayed to you in the creative map settings. For Example, Capture the Flag need flags placed in the level.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/18a8e3804c206e9ce08f2ee3cc20ecff2a77ecb3.png"]



Optimization

Something that has been changed is lighting optimization. The FPS is now slightly better on all levels.



Website

There is also a website for The Stickman! There’s nothing new on there right now but will eventually have level editor tips to help spark ideas or better explain the process I go through making my levels.

https://thestickmangame.com/




So when is it released?

Right now I still plan for The Stickman to release into early access later this year. Exact date is TBD as I don't want to stress myself out and release anything incomplete.



What am I working on next?

Finishing the level editor is my current task. After finishing the level editor, I need to program a bunch of PvP modes and make some PvP maps. There will be at least one map per mode on release. And everything needs to be tested before being released, then we should be good if everything goes well!



Thanks for reading and being patient! I'm working really hard to make sure everything is smooth on release.

notes.title: July 2025 Development Update and New Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello!
Hello fellow Stickman! I've been quiet for a while on The Stickman except for one stream I did in June with some updates and showcasing a new level mechanic. \[VOD Link: https://www.twitch.tv/thesimpleshark/v/2493491905?sr=a] In this update, I'm going to discuss changes to levels, gameplay and movement adjustments, along with the expansion of weapons, abilities, and talking about what's next.



Level Changes
There are a few changes from the demo to levels that I made after seeing multiple people run into the same issues. The goal with these changes is to make the game more fluid and not punish the player for taking a lot of time, or simply succeeding by collecting letters. 



The original idea was that you got 5 stars for collecting all letters, completing all encounters, and completing the level under Author time. Author time is the time it takes for the Author of the level (me) to complete the level. The author time was originally determined based on completing the level with 3 or less deaths.



Stars have been changed to 3 main objectives per level, Completion, finding Adventurous Alvin, and collecting all letters. Your time and improvement time is still shown when in Single Player but not coop. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/f35189eacec53a6a0d8a54ad6627d71e016668dc.jpg"]

Adventurous Alvin was not in the demo at all. You can find Adventurous Alvins flag somewhere very hidden in the level. The flag has a note which explains lore about the world of The Stickman.



It's important to note that if you unlocked the Golden Goose by getting 5 stars, you still keep it, even with the systems changing. 




A Whole New World
The biggest thing I've been working on is the second world of levels and environment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/c3b637e2e5fa4313c6e13e0dc47dffec97e24a49.jpg"]

The Jetpack

The Jetpack is 1 of the movement mechanics featured in the second world. Hit a JetPad to do a sick backflip, then ignite the Jetpack to fly in the direction you're facing. 
[previewyoutube="5e3p1AybLCg;full"][/previewyoutube]


The H.O.R.S.I.E

The H.O.R.S.I.E is the second movement mechanic featured in the second world. Once you reach a gate, you mount a H.O.R.S.I.E which is equipped with a Hot Dog Revolver and a S.N.O.T Rocket. It can also drift and do aerobatics while in the air!
[previewyoutube="DGVeISLQxKM;full"][/previewyoutube]

Weapons and Abilities
Each level introduces a unique loadout, which means every level has a new weapon, grenade, and special right now. I would love to montage and show you all of them, but I also want everything to be a surprise. So I'm not going to show any of them, but they're cool trust me.



Customization
Fixed multiple crashes and bugs that happened while drawing and creating skins.



Movement Adjustments
Turns out I had my numbers and nodes wrong. In the demo, some of the movement was based on framerate up to 60fps. Meaning that if you were under 60fps, the force was not being applied the same. If you were over 60fps, then you didn't experience this bug at all.




Updated Roadmap
This is the updated roadmap for what I'll be working on up until release into Early Access.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598600/743c251d558a7e31feca7c22b47a8bf7b32b3405.jpg"]

And that's it! If you read this far, then thanks! I hope to do an update every month, maybe every couple months depending on how busy I am or what I'm working on. Have a good rest of your day!



P.S I'm not even sure if what I created is a roadmap. It might be like an update or a task list, but I'm too lazy to change it

notes.title: Demo Patch 6/12/2025
notes.notes:
Another patch was released late last night and right now. Here are the main things that have been added and fixed:

Fixed crash that would happen when adjusting brush size when drawing

Fixed tutorial spawns

Hold Crouch now always attempts to put you in crouch state if it can

Fixed negative ammo alt fire bug with  Hot Dog Revolver

Fixed issue where weapon reload sounds were not adjusted by volume sliders

Fixed issue where special would lock up if you reset gauntlet while using it

Added option to have crouch disconnect the grapple
